overview: Build a compact sci‑fi rover/drone: a chunky rear cargo module, a short mid-chassis, twin side rollers, and a front sensor/camera pod (matching the reference silhouette: big block → small block → round elements → headlight-style front).

subassemblies.name: Rear cargo/engine module (main block)
subassemblies.description: Large rectangular brick-built box with a flat studded roof; optionally add a 1-plate-thick “beltline” around it for shape. This is the visual mass and connection point for the rest of the rover.
subassemblies.image_location: Left side: the largest light/dark gray block with studs on top.

subassemblies.name: Mid-chassis spacer (neck)
subassemblies.description: A smaller rectangular block that steps down from the rear module to the front section; keep it 2 studs wide and 2–4 studs long so the front details sit lower/forward.
subassemblies.image_location: Center-left: the smaller gray block attached to the main block.

subassemblies.name: Twin roller/drive units
subassemblies.description: Two identical side-mounted roller stacks: black round 1x1 cylinders as “wheels/rollers,” separated/trimmed with light gray round plates/tiles. Mount them symmetrically off the mid-chassis using plates so they read as paired drive pods.
subassemblies.image_location: Center-right: the two black cylindrical pieces with light gray round elements between/around them.

subassemblies.name: Front sensor/camera pod
subassemblies.description: A compact front end using a headlight brick (or similar SNOT-capable brick) to create a forward-facing ‘lens’/sensor. Add a small top plate/cheese slopes or tiles to taper the nose.
subassemblies.image_location: Far right: the black headlight-style brick with a round detail facing outward.

subassemblies.name: Top detailing (optional)
subassemblies.description: Greeble the roof of the rear module with small plates/tiles and a 1x1 round or grille to suggest vents; keep it low so the blocky profile remains.
subassemblies.image_location: Top of the left main block (studded area).

notes: Keep the rover about 6–8 studs long overall: rear module ~4x4 footprint, mid-chassis ~2x2 to 2x4, then the roller/sensor section.
Use available Light/Dark Bluish Gray bricks/plates for the body, Black round elements for rollers, and a Black headlight brick for the front lens mount.
Aim for simple, sturdy connections: stack-built boxes for the two body blocks; attach roller units via plates on the sides; front pod attached with a 2-stud-wide plate bridge.
If you want more interest without complexity: add small side ‘tool arms’ using clips/bars from your inventory, but keep them removable accessories.
